Chesapeake Court consists of General District Court and Circuit Court. The court had a legal professional community that served people in Chesapeake. The court takes authority in cases that involve wrongdoing, City ordinance violence, civil suits, minor cases, felony cases initial hearing and small claims of $25000. The court circuit cases involve five judges, who mostly hear civil or domestic issues. General District and Juvenile Domestic Relation Decision appeals are also attended by the court circuit.

How to do Payment?

Chesapeake Court Payment can be made in the following ways:

  • · Pay by Cash
  • · Pay by Personal Check
  • · Pay Online
  • · Pay by Company Checks from employees
  • · Pay by Certified or Cashier Check and money order
  • · Pay by Debit/Credit Card using Visa Master Card

Chesapeake Circuit Court:

Chesapeake Circuit Court is a general jurisdiction court served by five judges. The circuit court hears and solves cases related to Civil Cases, Domestic Cases like Divorce, Custody and many more. It also hears appeals from General District and Juvenile Domestic relations. The court works five days a week from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. The judge does not hear Sentencing, criminal and civil cases on Wednesday.

How to do Online Payment?

Chesapeake Circuit Court Online Payment can be made in two ways:

E-Check

You can pay online by e-check service via American Bank without any fees.

Credit Card

Pay using a credit card with a minimal transaction fee.

Chesapeake District Court

Chesapeake District Court hears all general cases without any jury trial. A judge hears all issues in court. The District Courts hears and solves cases that involve wrongdoing cases, traffic cases, city ordinance violence cases, initial; hearing of felony cases and small claims cases. The court hearing timing is 8:30 am to 4:30 pm. All information related to issues is available on the website.

see also Hennepin County Court

Chesapeake District Court Case Information

Chesapeake District Court Case Information can be found online using the name, case number, judge name, attorney name, party name or type, filling date, and by docket entry. By using any of these methods, you can get the case information for Chesapeake District court.

Chesapeake Divorce Court

Chesapeake Divorce Court contains all divorce information. The Circuit Court handles the divorce case. The divorce court consists of a contested and uncontested divorce manual. All divorce schedules and forms are also provided by the court.

Chesapeake Circuit Court Uncontested Divorce Form

Chesapeake Circuit Court Uncontested Divorce Form contains all the forms related to an uncontested divorce. Records that are available for an uncontested divorce are:

  • · No Support – Divorce Final Decree
  • · No Minor Child with spousal support- Divorce Final Decree
  • · Child Support- Divorce Final Decree
  • · Moving Party Affidavit
  • · Moving Party and Corroborating Witness Hearing Questions for Ore Tenus
  • · Personal Addendum for the Protection of Identifying Information
  • · Waiver for the Process and Notice of Future Services

Chesapeake Circuit Court Docket

Chesapeake Circuit Court Docket provides online docket services to the community. 2020 to date, circuit court docket information is available monthly. The daily docket is also available but not online; you have to go to the general or circuit court building if you want the information for the daily docket.

Chesapeake Traffic Court Pay Online

Chesapeake Traffic Court Pay Online is a new system introduced by the court. The traffic fine can be paid online by using Virginia’s Judicial System.

How to get Marriage License?

Chesapeake Court Marriage License is Circuit Court Service provided when a person meets some legal requirements. A person must submit an online form for the marriage license, and the fee for the permit is $30. A photo for personal identification is mandatory.

How to Probate?

Chesapeake Court Probate is the formal proving of the deceased person's will as the authentic and valid will, and it must be approved by submitting the document records in the Clerk's Office. It will happen in the city or country where the deceased person lives or has a resident.

FAQ

What is a land record yearly subscription in Chesapeake Court?

Chesapeake Court's yearly subscription for the land record is $600 per subscriber.

Who inherits the property of a person who dies intestate (a person dying without a will)?

If someone dies without a will, then according to Virginia law Chesapeake Court will provide descents a course that is given below:

  • · The property will be given to all the surviving spouses unless the person has no child.
  • · All property will be given to children if the spouse dies.
  • · If the person had no spouse, no child, then all property will be given to the person's mother or father or any other alive family member

Where can one go for more information or answer specific questions?

Visit or contact the Clerk of Circuit Court or the clerk available in the Probate office. You can also get your attorney for any information.

What are the services provided by the Chesapeake Circuit Court Clerk?

Chesapeake Circuit Court Clerk Services includes:

  • Handgun Permission Service
  • Marriage License Service
  • Probate Service
  • Docket Service

What is the Chesapeake Court Dress Code?

Chesapeake Court Dress Code must be representable, neat and clean. It must show respect for the court. Loose T-shirts, flip-flop shoes, shorts and indecent dressing are not allowed in the court.
